data.name: Echo Tech Carbon Corporation
data.description: Echo Tech Carbon Corporation is a Vancouver-based biochar project developer operating primarily in equatorial Africa (Uganda). It converts agricultural and landfill bio-waste into biochar via pyrolysis for soil amendment and construction materials, and sells biochar carbon removal credits listed on Puro.earth and cdr.fyi.
